overview: The Outer Temple is the first defensive layer of the Shissar empire.
details: Serpent sentries guard the entrances, venom wards protect sacred corridors, and cursed statues animate when disturbed. The Gatewarden oversees all outer defenses.
hooks: A venom ward flares as intruders approach.
Cursed statues animate and block passage.
Imperial patrols mobilize for a purge.
The Gatewarden issues a challenge to trespassers.
